Queen II (Collector's Edition) [2026]
Music / Hard Rock / Glam Rock | FLAC & MP3 320kbps | Collector's Edition

Originally released in 1974, "Queen II" is often considered by devoted fans as the British band's heavy, progressive masterpiece. With its iconic division into the "White Side" (composed by Brian May and Roger Taylor) and the "Black Side" (composed entirely by Freddie Mercury), the album is an outpouring of creativity, operatic choirs, heavy riffs, and dark fantasy.
This spectacular 2026 Collector's Edition delivers 58 tracks spread across 5 parts. It includes the new HD mixes (2026 Mix), an extensive collection of demos, outtakes, and instrumental tracks (Backing Tracks), as well as legendary BBC sessions and explosive live performances at iconic venues like the Golders Green Hippodrome and The Rainbow. A definitive experience available in both MP3 and the highest fidelity FLAC.
